title: Event Feed
description: Declares a business's agent-subscribable commerce event feed. Agents discover this via the profile and choose a supported transport to receive typed commerce events without out-of-band configuration.

url.description: Base URL for the event feed endpoint.

event_types.description: Commerce event types this business emits. Use reverse-domain notation (e.g. dev.ucp.order.status_changed).

transports.description: Supported delivery transports for this feed. At least one must be present.

items.description: webhook: business pushes to a caller-registered URL. sse: caller opens a long-lived GET. poll: caller GETs the url with optional cursor.

poll_cursor_param.description: Query parameter name for the cursor token when transport includes 'poll'. Defaults to 'after' if omitted.
